Our Heritage & Lineage

Three Decades of Uncompromising Marine Craftsmanship

Rooted in the renowned shipbuilding traditions of Pula and operating directly from the historic Avangard Shipyard, Heritage Decks is spearheaded by master marine carpenter Perica Bajs. For over 30 years, our workshop has engineered bespoke teak decks, combining hand-selected timber, precision jointing, and vacuum bonding to meet the exacting standards of international luxury yachts and heritage vessels.

Condition Assessment & Consulting

4-Step Digital Refit Process

Our Precision Engineering & Crafting Workflow

A disciplined 4-stage digital refit methodology delivering millimeter perfection from initial scan to final handover.

01

3D Scan & Digital Twin

High-precision on-site laser scanning creates an exact digital replica of the vessel's deck layout and curvature.

02

Workshop Prefabrication

CNC milling, hand selection of uniform quarter-sawn grain, and vacuum-bonded panel construction in climate-controlled conditions.

03

On-Site Vacuum Bonding

Fast and clean on-vessel installation using advanced marine structural adhesives and continuous vacuum clamping without screws.

04

Finishing & Handover

Multi-stage orbital sanding, seam caulking inspection, application of breathable marine sealants, and client sign-off.

Questions & Answers

Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about our teak decks, maintenance, and project lifecycles.

What is 3D deck laser scanning and why is it superior?

3D laser scanning captures millions of coordinates across your yacht's deck in minutes, achieving sub-millimeter precision. It eliminates inaccuracies of manual cardboard templating, allows 90% of deck assembly in our workshop, and drastically reduces the boat's downtime in the marina.

What timber species do you work with?

We specialize in genuine Burmese Golden Teak (Tectona grandis) sourced with strict sustainability documentation. We also craft high-performance synthetic composite decks and plantation-grown alternative hardwoods depending on your project specifications.

How long does a typical teak deck refit take?

Thanks to workshop prefabrication, actual on-board installation is reduced to 7-14 days for mid-size motor yachts and sailing boats. Total project time from digital survey to handover typically spans 3 to 5 weeks.

Are screws used to secure the new deck?

Never. We use modern vacuum-assisted adhesive bonding. By avoiding screws through the deck core, your subdeck remains 100% watertight, preventing any potential fiberglass delamination or core rot.

Where is your primary facility and what territory do you cover?

Our main workshop and prefabrication base is situated within the historic Avangard Shipyard in Pula, Istria. In addition, our mobile team directly serves all ports across Croatia, Italy (Venice, Trieste, Monfalcone, Ancona), and Slovenia.
